scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes

name: minizip-ng
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes

name: miniz
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: miniz archive reader; its DEFLATE implementation is integrated.

name: libgsf
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Own ZIP directory and entry API; uses compression dependencies for DEFLATE.

name: kuba-zip
input_api: zip_open(const char*, int, char); zip_entries_total; zip_entry_openbyindex; zip_entry_name; zip_entry_read
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Distinct package API that embeds miniz for ZIP parsing and DEFLATE; shares underlying parser lineage with miniz.

name: zziplib
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Own ZIP archive reader; uses zlib for DEFLATE.

name: unarr
input_api: ar_open_file(const char*); ar_open_zip_archive; ar_parse_entry; ar_entry_get_name; ar_entry_uncompress
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: selmf/unarr fork of zeniko/unarr; its ZIP parser and decompression API are part of the pinned source package.

name: physfs
input_api: PHYSFS_mount(local ZIP path); PHYSFS_enumerateFiles; PHYSFS_openRead; PHYSFS_readBytes
scope: mounted ZIP entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: PhysicsFS provides a distinct virtual filesystem package API with an internal ZIP archive handler; its C++ call site reuses this C library.

name: sqlite
input_api: sqlite3_zipfile_init(db,0,0); sqlite3_prepare_v2 SELECT name,data FROM zipfile(?1); bind local ZIP path; sqlite3_step
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family: SQLite Zipfile virtual table with zlib DEFLATE
family_note: Official SQLite ext/misc/zipfile.c extension parses ZIP archive records and delegates DEFLATE to zlib; its repository stars measure all SQLite usage, not Zipfile adoption.
